Class HandlerMethod<R>

java.lang.Object
io.micronaut.web.router.builder.HandlerMethod<R>
Type Parameters:
R - The result type
All Implemented Interfaces:
AnnotatedElement, AnnotationMetadata, AnnotationMetadataDelegate, AnnotationMetadataProvider, AnnotationSource, Described, Named, Executable<Object,R>, ExecutableMethod<Object,R>, ExecutionHandle<Object,R>, MethodExecutionHandle<Object,R>, MethodReference<Object,R>
@Internal public final class HandlerMethod<R> extends Object implements ExecutableMethod<Object,R>, MethodExecutionHandle<Object,R>
A route handler function presented as an executable method, so that a route to it binds arguments, selects an executor, runs filters and encodes the result exactly like a route to a controller method.
Since:
5.3.0
Author:
Denis Stepanov

    Description
    static interface 
    HandlerMethod.SseResponder
    Runs the handler of a server-sent events route, bound by the server for the invocation of the route: it creates the SseEmitter of the response, and keeps what the binding of the body of the route left open until the stream ends.

    • getTargetMethod

      public Method getTargetMethod()
      A route to a handler function has no Java method: the router, the binding and the execution of the route never need one. Only a route that implements a bean method, see RouteSpec.annotationMetadata(AnnotationMetadataProvider), has the target method of that bean method. That bean method is also the element of the route, see MethodBasedRouteInfo.getAnnotationMetadataProvider().
      Specified by:
      getTargetMethod in interface MethodReference<Object,R>
      Returns:
      The target method of the bean method the route implements
      Throws:
      UnsupportedOperationException - if the route implements no bean method
